visual_findings: At native 256 canvas and 4x nearest enlargement, three holes and the darker 10px lower-paper strip remain readable; middle-frame holes reveal A and final apertures reveal background.
The smaller study genuinely uses 20 paper colors and 21 scene colors with binary layer alpha; it preserves rigid layer geometry after the single initial resample.

It still reads as sampled paper texture rather than deliberately designed broad pixel clusters. Numerous isolated near-color flecks remain, and the palette contains several very close parchment tones. Numeric palette compliance is not an aesthetic pixel-art acceptance.

Top hole is 5x4 while the lower two are 5x5 after one-time sampling; both layers match exactly, but this is a new experimental shape, not a faithful source-resolution hole shape or verified engine grid.
